# Premiere Pro Open AI Specification

This repository is an AI-native specification and knowledge operating system for Adobe Premiere Pro.

It is generated by **PPAIKB Builder**.

## Core goals

- Formal object model for Premiere Pro
- AI-safe automation rules
- Hallucination-resistant API guidance
- RAG-ready atomic Markdown documents
- Knowledge graph and validation tooling
- Production workflows for postproduction, captions, XML, MOGRT and VFX
